N-2.1-A.skill: combine average rates of change over adjacent intervals using total change, not by averaging or subtracting the rates.

N-2.1-B.skill: decide which conclusions follow from an average rate of change over an interval, separating net change from pointwise or monotonic claims.

N-2.2-A.skill: evaluate a scaled or offset difference quotient as a multiple of f′(a), tracking the coefficients of h in both terms.

N-2.2-B.skill: recognize a limit of the form (g(x) − g(a))/(x² − a²) as a derivative divided by (x + a), evaluating the extra factor.

N-2.3-A.skill: use monotonic f′ to place f′ at a point strictly between the adjacent secant slopes, rather than treating the centered estimate as exact.

N-2.3-B.skill: estimate the derivative of a linear combination of two tabulated functions by applying the same difference quotient to the combination, keeping coefficients and signs.

N-2.4-A.skill: identify which function is differentiable at a point by diagnosing corners, cusps, and vertical tangents among similar-looking formulas.

N-2.4-B.skill: conclude correctly about continuity and differentiability from one-sided information, avoiding the converse and averaging errors.

N-2.5-A.skill: find the point of tangency for a tangent line to a power curve that passes through a given external point, by setting up and solving the tangent-line condition.

N-2.5-B.skill: rewrite a product or quotient of radicals as a single power before differentiating, and avoid differentiating each factor separately or mishandling exponents.

N-2.6-A.skill: find the tangent line to a linear combination of functions from the tangent lines of the pieces, combining slopes and values with the coefficients.

N-2.6-B.skill: use f′ = c·g′ (or f′ = g′ + k) to conclude that a related combination of f and g is constant, rather than that f and g are equal.

N-2.7-A.skill: find the slope of a tangent line to y = ln x or y = eˣ that passes through a given external point, by solving the tangent-line condition for the point of tangency.

N-2.7-B.skill: evaluate a high-order derivative of sin x, cos x, and eˣ by identifying the cycle of length four and the remainder of the order.

N-2.8-A.skill: differentiate a product of three factors, one given only by table values, tracking every term of the product rule.

N-2.8-B.skill: locate horizontal tangent lines of a product by solving f′ = 0, separating critical points from zeros of f and from errors in the product rule.

N-2.9-A.skill: apply the quotient rule when the numerator or denominator is itself a sum or product involving values of f, g, f′, g′, tracking every term and the order of subtraction.

N-2.9-B.skill: reverse the quotient rule: from a given tangent-slope condition on f/g (or g/f or xf/g) solve for an unknown derivative value.

N-2.10-A.skill: write and use the tangent line to y = sec x, csc x, cot x, or tan x at a point to find where that line crosses the x-axis.

N-2.10-B.skill: simplify a product of trigonometric functions with an identity before differentiating, and recognize product-rule sign and product-of-derivatives errors.
